reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 34. Nay or No: 5. Not Voting: 1. Of 39 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 39 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

finance.disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
finance.cycle_rule: House filings use the 2026 two-year cycle.
finance.scope_note: Figures are committee receipts and itemized Schedule A for this two-year cycle only. This is not career fundraising. Schedule E outside spending is not included.
finance.contributor_note: Itemized Schedule A receipts for this principal campaign committee and cycle, grouped by contributor name. Memo lines are omitted so an earmark is not counted twice. Unitemized donations are not in this list. Not every Schedule A row was retrieved, so this ranking uses the largest receipts returned and can miss contributors whose gifts are smaller but add up.

lobbying_summary.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.

running.label: Candidates who filed with the FEC for this seat. Filing is not the same as being on the ballot. Primary results and ballot access are not shown.
incumbent_notes: Juan Ciscomani has a 2026 filing for this seat (FEC H2AZ02360, FEC lists: Incumbent). Not counted below.

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.
donor_industry.cycle_rule: House filings use the 2026 two-year cycle.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.
stands_for.factual_flag: Not yet summarized: this line is built only from the official vote question and the bill's official title.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating loss of three precious young members of the Salpointe community. Our thoughts and prayers are with their families and all those whose lives have been touched by this unimaginable tragedy.

Please join Laura and me in lifting them up in https://t.co/znW9RTJkbc

This National Veterans Small Business Week, we recognize veterans like Chris, owner of Black Rifle Coffee, who continue to serve their communities in a different way. Their commitment to something bigger than themselves does not end when they take off the uniform. It carries on https://t.co/Cl7Ol4uJWG

Today, we honor the men and women who have worn our nation’s uniform and answered the call to serve. Their courage, sacrifice, and commitment to protecting our freedoms will never be forgotten. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/0swDIWSueV

Today is Election Day! 🇺🇸

Make a plan to vote and make your voice heard. Mail-in ballots are no longer accepted by mail, but you can drop off your mail-in ballot at any polling location or ballot drop box.

Find the information you need here: https://t.co/ROfMMTWMRQ https://t.co/KWC6F14wzD

.@uarizona is leading the way in space innovation! 🚀

Grateful to join the inaugural Space Forum to highlight the groundbreaking work happening right here in Southern Arizona. Proud to champion $2 million in federal funding to advance these innovations and keep Arizona at the forefront of space exploration. Bear down 🐻⬇️

Relationships matter, no matter the party.

I have a proven track record of working with both Democratic and Republican administrations to deliver results for Southern Arizona.

That’s my record, and it’s the experience and commitment I’ll continue to bring to the table. https://t.co/KsGjOshQpj

4 📸’s of the week!

Another busy week serving Southern Arizona! From advancing critical water research to seeing the incredible innovation happening at @uarizona, it was another week of progress across the Sixth. 💪🇺🇸 https://t.co/7Z8SbodvG2

Congratulations to the Vail School District on being Arizona's best-ranked district! 

This achievement is a testament to the teachers and faculty who strive for excellence and make Vail such a great place to learn and grow. Arizona’s students deserve the best, and Vail is setting that very standard!

https://t.co/SSkpQ3wvtc

I fought to secure this critical investment for Southern Arizona.

Proud to see our local communities leading the way in America’s mining resurgence 🇺🇸 https://t.co/Co2yOembA1

Great to join Tangerine Farms K-8 for Walk and Roll 2026! 🚲

Healthy habits start young, and it was great to see so much energy and enthusiasm from these students. Thank you to the teachers and staff who made this event possible and continue to invest in our kids and their future!

Great to join Mrs. Jackie Shope at Tangerine Farms K-8 in Marana this morning for Pima County’s annual Rock ’N’ Roll event!

Nothing is more important than keeping our kids safe. Proud to support efforts that help students get to school safely and start their day off right!🚸 https://t.co/HchsTWZkLG

Second chances do exist because of incredible organizations like Gospel Rescue Mission.

Proud to see our local community come together to change lives, restore hope, and help individuals build a brighter future 🫂 https://t.co/BYDZkebBB5

Gospel Rescue Mission and the Center of Opportunity are taking a holistic approach to helping Arizonans experiencing homelessness rebuild their lives.

Grateful to bring @SecTurner to Tucson to see firsthand how this proven model is changing lives and how we can replicate its success nationwide.

Southern Arizona moves forward when we work together. By bringing Democrats, Republicans, and Independents to the table, we’re turning local priorities into over $42.7 Million for meaningful investments for AZ-06 🇺🇸 https://t.co/CjXpFBEy3m

.@SecretaryTurner and I visited the Center of Opportunity in Tucson to see firsthand the impact of strong local partnerships.

Together, they have helped more than 740 individuals complete addiction recovery, offering a second chance and a path toward rebuilding their lives 🫂 https://t.co/Un9vcWHE8S

$8.5 million for Southern Arizona’s first responders! 🇺🇸

Our first responders put their lives on the line to keep our communities safe. I’m fighting in Congress to deliver the resources they need to protect and serve families across every corner of our district. https://t.co/SRVQdSHlvh

From our law enforcement officers and firefighters to EMTs, corrections officers, and dispatchers, these hometown heroes answer the call running towards danger when Arizonans need them most.

Thank you to EVERY first responder across AZ06! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/HIc7nKABcO

Water is our MOST precious resource, and we must continue to use it strategically.

Proud to see @USDA investing in our communities embracing emerging technologies and innovative solutions to make the most of our limited water supply! https://t.co/W1ETMrNvA0

Proud to join @SecRollins for the ribbon cutting of the new $12.4 million state-of-the-art lab at the Southwest Watershed Research Center in Tucson.

This investment will advance critical agricultural research and help address water challenges across Southern Arizona.

Thank you, https://t.co/LlCLkYXTin

Our hometown heroes deserve someone who will always fight for them.

I will never stop standing up for those who serve our communities and making sure their voices are heard in Congress. https://t.co/sHCcZwGkwb

Honored to deliver the keynote address at Fort Huachuca 50’s Annual Dinner!

Fort Huachuca is a pillar of our community. I will always fight for our service members and the future of this installation, just as I did in helping secure a new mission for the Fort 🇺🇸 https://t.co/MYFAyw4VEc

Honored to deliver the keynote address at Fort Huachuca 50’s Annual Dinner!

Fort Huachuca is a pillar of our community. I will always fight for our service members and the future of this installation, just as I did in helping secure a new mission for the Fort 🇺🇸 https://t.co/wk6ZQ3yBGI

Thank you, @POTUS! After more than 100 years as a monument, your signature officially created: Chiricahua National Park, giving Arizona our 4th national park. 

Preserving our public lands for future generations is an invaluable inheritance to our children and grandchildren.  I https://t.co/7JXfHPEkYc

Great to stop by WowWow in Oro Valley and catch up with owner Jeff Laird and his wife Laura!

Founded in Hawaii, WowWow is a great example of how small businesses bring something unique to Southern Arizona and help make our communities special! 🌵 https://t.co/SoJ9AbfPq3

As the second bill I ever introduced in Congress, protecting Chiricahua has been a priority from day one.

What began as a decade-long Arizona priority is now a reality. This is what delivering for Southern Arizona looks like! https://t.co/fS81EY9aUe

Arizona’s newest national park is a must-see! 

Discover Chiricahua National Park, now our nation’s 64th national park, right here in #AZ06! https://t.co/HOXmwMOqA2

Proud to be back at the @uarizona during Homecoming week to join President Garimella and community leaders for the State of the University Luncheon!

This year, I secured $20 million for the School of Mining, investing in our students and the future of Southern Arizona. Bear Down! 🐻⬇️

Incredibly PROUD to have led the bipartisan effort to make Chiricahua our nation’s 64th national park! 🇺🇸🌵

A decade of hard work and persistence paid off. This is a win for Southern Arizona and a legacy for generations to come! https://t.co/85yQNYnymj

Grateful to join so many members of our local community for Oro Valley Mayor Joe Winfield’s final State of the Town Address!

What makes #AZ06 special is the Arizonans who call it home. It was great to hear directly from local small business owners about their vision for our community’s future!

An Arizona priority a decade in the making is now a reality: Chiricahua National Park

Years of bipartisan collaboration, persistence, and hard work has paid off! https://t.co/FNrLAPWPWs

Add our newest national park - Chiricahua National Park - to your bucket list! 🏜️🇺🇸

Southern Arizona is excited to welcome you! https://t.co/IQTz3WilLV
What an INCREDIBLE sight at @copper_gunnison! 💥 https://t.co/bFVic5lJaE

As the most effective member of Arizona’s delegation, I fought to turn a decade-long effort into reality and secure Chiricahua as Arizona’s FOURTH national park!

Protecting our public lands is an Arizona priority. That is how you DELIVER for Southern Arizona! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/x8IeiMTtfX

So PROUD to celebrate Chiricahua becoming Arizona’s FOURTH national park alongside Gabbi, who has been behind the scenes on this effort since day one!

This is more than a milestone. It is a legacy we will leave for generations to come! 🇺🇸🏜️ https://t.co/AjSETGFHd7

Next stop: Chiricahua National Park!

A decade-long effort is now across the finishline, thank you @POTUS! https://t.co/1Q7nZlys90

Chiricahua deserves to be preserved for our children and grandchildren to enjoy for generations to come.

Proud to have helped lead this effort across the finish line and protect Arizona’s natural beauty for generations to come! https://t.co/ip1mX3jwYM

Arizona is at the HEART of America’s mining resurgence! Great to be in Cochise County with @SecretaryBurgum to showcase @copper_gunnison’s unmatched innovation and highlight how Cochise County is a leader in strengthen our nation’s critical mineral supply! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/gZbavfQYQs

PROUD to celebrate with @SecretaryBurgum as we mark the signing of my bill to make Chiricahua Arizona’s FOURTH national park!

Thank you, @POTUS, for signing this historic legislation and helping make Chiricahua our nation’s 64th National Park! A once-in-a-generation achievement to preserve this Arizona treasure for generations to come!

Signed. Sealed. Delivered. 

Arizona’s FOURTH national park: Chiricahua!

Thank you, POTUS! https://t.co/inxPEga35g

On the ground at Gunnison Copper in Cochise County with @SecretaryBurgum, where one project holds more than 5 BILLION pounds of measured copper resources!

Arizona is leading the way in strengthening America’s domestic critical mineral supply and unleashing our nation’s FULL potential! 🇺🇸

Packed day on the road! 🇺🇸

Kicking the day off at the Southern Arizona Home Builders Association to discuss investing in our children through Head Start and expanding pathways for students to enter Arizona’s highly competitive construction trades right here in #AZ06💪 https://t.co/BTU1zI3Bp5

Southern Arizona Home Builders Association is helping BUILD the future of our communities by preparing the next generation of workers!

That is why I introduced the CONSTRUCTS Act to expand access to trade schools and help more Arizonans pursue careers in the skilled trades 🇺🇸 https://t.co/0rTUOt2103

$3 million for Thatcher’s First Avenue widening project would be a game changer for Graham County.

PROUD to join Mayor Jenny Howard and so many great members of our community to hear directly from them about how this project can improve everyday life for families across Graham County. The people who live here know what their community needs, and I’m listening.

Incredibly grateful to my Veteran Advisory Council for their continued partnership in making sure the needs of our local veterans are heard and addressed in Washington. Those who served our nation deserve our FULL support, and I will continue working to ensure their voices are heard and their sacrifices honored 🇺🇸

Friday night lights in #AZ06! 🏈

Great to be at Buena High School last night to watch the Colts take on the Casa Grande Cougars and join the players and coaches for the pregame coin toss. As a flag football coach, I always enjoy supporting our student-athletes and cheering them on in the community.

Protecting Arizona’s public lands has been a priority since day one in Congress🌵

As the SECOND bill I ever introduced, making Chiricahua Arizona’s FOURTH National Park has been a personal mission from the start. https://t.co/NlfBWINjtU

Since 2024, I have honored over 170 hometown heroes through our Veteran Servant Leader Award Ceremony, recognizing the veterans who continue to make a difference in our communities. 

It is truly a privilege to recognize their sacrifices and ensure their service is never forgotten 🇺🇸

WRDA was PACKED with wins! 

$53 MILLION is set to come to Southern Arizona to support critical water infrastructure and protect our water future.

We as Arizonans know water is our lifeline. PROUD to support this bipartisan bill that delivers for ALL of Arizona 💪 https://t.co/8yDw03bget

Wolf predation has taken a serious toll on ranching operations and the livelihoods of hardworking Arizona ranchers. 

Arizona MUST reevaluate current wolf management policies to further ensure ranchers have the resources needed to protect their livestock and sustain their operations that they have worked generations to build.

https://t.co/r3fMkVmx2O

BIG NEWS for Southern Arizona! 🏜️

After nearly a decade of bipartisan work, Chiricahua National Monument is about to become Chiricahua National Park! A historic milestone that puts #AZ06 on the map! https://t.co/QgFkXypdJ7

Fantastic energy at my alma mater, Pima Community College! 

Enjoyed stopping by to meet with bright students and see firsthand how the $900,000 I’m fighting for in Congress will help create new STEM opportunities on campus and prepare students for the high-demand careers of tomorrow 📚

Simply no better way to start the day than at Marana Mornings with @RepGuthrie!

From plumbers and painters to local retailers, Arizona’s small businesses and hardworking people keep our communities moving. Proud to represent the people who make AZ-06 a great place to live and share an update!

Incredibly honored to host my 6th Veteran Servant Leader Award Ceremony, recognizing 27 hometown heroes. Representing every major branch of our Armed Forces, these veterans were nominated by fellow members of our community who see firsthand the difference they make every day 🇺🇸 https://t.co/tyw2qw7lTe

A courthouse built more than 110 years ago deserves an upgrade for the next 100.

Great to visit the Graham County Courthouse and see firsthand how the $2M in funding I’m advocating for would help modernize this historic landmark and better serve the needs of rural Arizona today! https://t.co/fGpU7Wlj45

PROUD to have worked across the aisle to build bridges and deliver REAL RESULTS for AZ06.

I’ll work with anyone, regardless of party, when it means getting things done for Arizona while standing up for the commonsense principles that reflect the fabric of our community 💪 https://t.co/avBnAu7wjm

Great to join more than 300 members of the Southern Arizona business community at the Chamber’s Annual Luncheon. 

As a former Chamber member, I know firsthand how vital the Chamber’s role is in supporting the local businesses right here 🇺🇸💪 https://t.co/vlrKtoFUKH

$3 MILLION SECURED AND DELIVERED! 🇺🇸

Proud to help secure $3 MILLION in for the new Potoff Private Philanthropy Center for Technological Innovation at PIMA JTED, where students will have new opportunities to build their skills in the trades! https://t.co/OxYaGo6FNZ

Happy Birthday to the U.S. Navy! 🇺🇸⚓️

Today, we honor every sailor who has answered the call to serve our nation. Thank you to the brave men and women who uphold the Navy’s core values of Honor, Courage, and Commitment #SemperFortis https://t.co/KC0GSwCjWD

Another great Alzheimer’s Walk in the books! 💜

Grateful for all raising awareness for this devastating disease that impacts so many Southern Arizona families. In Congress, I have introduced bipartisan legislation to improve early detection resources for Alzheimer’s https://t.co/okgtpbOkdo

As National Fire Prevention Week comes to a close, we recognize the brave firefighters who step up when emergency strikes. 

I’m fighting to deliver $1.3 million in federal funding for a new quint ladder truck in Huachuca City, equipping local firefighters with the BEST resources for AZ-06💪

Grateful to join so many members of our community for the annual Alzheimer’s Walk at Reid Park in Tucson!

Together, we are working toward a future without Alzheimer’s and supporting the many families right here in Southern Arizona impacted by this devastating disease💜 https://t.co/nHeTFDaa4w

Another fantastic week in the books, traveling all across Southern Arizona.

Serving the Sixth District never stops!🇺🇲 https://t.co/Hes9BUQnAQ

$2 MILLION for Sahuarita! 🚔🇺🇸

Great to visit the Sahuarita Police Department with my good friends Mayor Murphy and @RepNateMoran to see firsthand how this investment I’m fighting for in Congress will strengthen communication technology and equip our officers with the BEST resources possible to keep our community safe! #BackTheBlue

An effort more than a decade in the making is now just one signature away!

Others have worked for years to get this across the finish line, and I’m proud to say we are getting it done.

Southern Arizona, get ready to welcome our second national park to AZ-06! 🏜️ https://t.co/6bf9eEFgG1

Fantastic to stop by Black Rifle Coffee in Tucson this morning and run into owner Chris Koering!

Veteran-founded and proudly supporting those who have served our country. Always great to see veteran-owned businesses thriving right here in Southern Arizona! 🇺🇸☕️ https://t.co/I5CVAEfVqb

Congratulations to my good friend Sandra Watson on being named Woman of the Year!

I had the privilege of working with Sandra during our time in the Ducey Administration and saw firsthand her dedication to growing Arizona’s economy and moving our local communities forward. So well deserved, Sandra!

https://t.co/sj0IoENEQI

Graham County deserves a fighter in Congress who will go to bat for them.

PROUD to be advocating to bring $6.3M back to Graham County for local projects that come from ideas brought directly to me by Arizonans  who know their communities and will have the greatest impact 💪 https://t.co/3xRnZwpUoZ

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month, and I’m PROUD to fight for the resources women in Graham County need. At Mt. Graham Regional Medical Center I heard directly about the need for a new mammography machine. Women in Graham County should not have to travel hours for lifesaving screenings. 

PROUD to fight to deliver this critical resource and ensure women in Graham County have the care they need, right in rural AZ💪

Getting my Chiricahua National Park Act across the finish line was truly a TEAM effort!

I’m PROUD to celebrate this WIN for AZ06 alongside the local advocates who helped make it happen. Together, we are ushering in Arizona’s 4th national park! 🏜️ https://t.co/kR3PJFX8tD
